list_collections: list collections on the Hugging Face Hub with optional owner, item, sort, and limit filters
create_collection: create a new collection on the Hugging Face Hub with a title, description, and optional private flag
update_collection: update a collection's metadata including title, description, position, privacy, and theme
add_item_to_collection: add a model, dataset, space, paper, collection, or bucket item to a collection with an optional note
delete_collection: delete a collection from the Hugging Face Hub by its slug with optional missing-ok flag
